requirements.title: Establish and Maintain Detailed Enterprise Asset Inventory
requirements.control_name: Inventory and Control of Enterprise Assets
requirements.guidance: Inventory all enterprise assets, including regularly connected assets outside enterprise control; record ownership, identifiers and authorization status, and reconcile changes.
requirements.official_text: Establish and maintain an accurate, detailed, and up-to-date inventory of all enterprise assets with the potential to store or process data, to include: end-user devices (including portable and mobile), network devices, non-computing/IoT devices, and servers. Ensure the inventory records the network address (if static), hardware address, machine name, enterprise asset owner, department for each asset, and whether the asset has been approved to connect to the network. For mobile end-user devices, MDM type tools can support this process, where appropriate. This inventory includes assets connected to the infrastructure physically, virtually, remotely, and those within cloud environments. Additionally, it includes assets that are regularly connected to the enterprise’s network infrastructure, even if they are not under control of the enterprise. Review and update the inventory of all enterprise assets bi-annually, or more frequently.

requirements.title: Address Unauthorized Assets
requirements.control_name: Inventory and Control of Enterprise Assets
requirements.guidance: Remove, block or isolate devices that lack authorization.
requirements.official_text: Ensure that a process exists to address unauthorized assets on a weekly basis. The enterprise may choose to remove the asset from the network, deny the asset from connecting remotely to the network, or quarantine the asset.

requirements.title: Utilize an Active Discovery Tool
requirements.control_name: Inventory and Control of Enterprise Assets
requirements.guidance: Discover connected devices automatically. Run discovery and reconcile unexpected devices.

operating_guidance.client_provider_split: IT/provider discovers and reconciles; client owners resolve authorization.
operating_guidance.establish: Configure discovery coverage and accountable operator.
operating_guidance.operate: Run discovery and reconcile unexpected devices.

requirements.official_text: Utilize an active discovery tool to identify assets connected to the enterprise’s network. Configure the active discovery tool to execute daily, or more frequently.

requirements.title: Use Dynamic Host Configuration Protocol (DHCP) Logging to Update Enterprise Asset Inventory
requirements.control_name: Inventory and Control of Enterprise Assets
requirements.source_cadence: At least weekly inventory updates using logs.
requirements.guidance: Use logs from all DHCP servers or IP address management tools to keep the asset inventory current. Review and use those logs at least weekly.

operating_guidance.client_provider_split: IT/provider discovers and reconciles; client owners resolve authorization.
operating_guidance.establish: Identify all DHCP servers or IP address management tools and the inventory reconciliation owner.
operating_guidance.operate: Collect observations and resolve inventory differences.

requirements.official_text: Use DHCP logging on all DHCP servers or Internet Protocol (IP) address management tools to update the enterprise’s asset inventory. Review and use logs to update the enterprise’s asset inventory weekly, or more frequently.

requirements.title: Use a Passive Asset Discovery Tool
requirements.control_name: Inventory and Control of Enterprise Assets
requirements.source_cadence: At least weekly: review discovery results and use them to update inventory. Passive discovery operates between those reviews.
requirements.guidance: Discover connected assets passively; use the results to refresh the asset inventory at least weekly.

operating_guidance.accountable_role: Responsible client team or provider (client to identify)
operating_guidance.client_provider_split: Client approves scope and exceptions; the responsible client team or provider performs the activity and supplies relevant records.
operating_guidance.establish: Confirm monitored network segments and reconcile dated discoveries to inventory entries. Trace an unknown asset through ownership and authorization decisions; check gaps between weekly reconciliations.
operating_guidance.operate: Discover connected assets passively; use the results to refresh the asset inventory at least weekly. At least weekly: review discovery results and use them to update inventory. Passive discovery operates between those reviews.
operating_guidance.dependencies: Safeguard 4.2: Establish and Maintain a Secure Configuration Process for Network Infrastructure Safeguard 12.4: Establish and Maintain Architecture Diagram(s)

requirements.official_text: Use a passive discovery tool to identify assets connected to the enterprise’s network. Review and use scans to update the enterprise’s asset inventory at least weekly, or more frequently.

requirements.title: Establish and Maintain a Software Inventory
requirements.control_name: Inventory and Control of Software Assets
requirements.guidance: Track installed software, ownership, licensing and business purpose.
requirements.official_text: Establish and maintain a detailed inventory of all licensed software installed on enterprise assets. The software inventory must document the title, publisher, initial install/use date, and business purpose for each entry; where appropriate, include the Uniform Resource Locator (URL), app store(s), version(s), deployment mechanism, decommission date, and number of licenses. Review and update the software inventory bi-annually, or more frequently.

requirements.title: Ensure Authorized Software is Currently Supported
requirements.control_name: Inventory and Control of Software Assets
requirements.guidance: Check vendor support and document necessary unsupported-software exceptions.
requirements.official_text: Ensure that only currently supported software is designated as authorized in the software inventory for enterprise assets. If software is unsupported, yet necessary for the fulfillment of the enterprise’s mission, document an exception detailing mitigating controls and residual risk acceptance. For any unsupported software without an exception documentation, designate as unauthorized. Review the software list to verify software support at least monthly, or more frequently.

requirements.title: Address Unauthorized Software
requirements.control_name: Inventory and Control of Software Assets
requirements.guidance: Review unauthorized installations and record removal or approved exceptions.
requirements.official_text: Ensure that unauthorized software is either removed from use on enterprise assets or receives a documented exception. Review monthly, or more frequently.

requirements.title: Utilize Automated Software Inventory Tools
requirements.control_name: Inventory and Control of Software Assets
requirements.guidance: Automate installed-software visibility where possible. Maintain discovery coverage and inventory feed.

operating_guidance.client_provider_split: IT/provider manages inventory/enforcement; client approves business exceptions.
operating_guidance.establish: Choose coverage and document technical limitations.
operating_guidance.operate: Maintain discovery coverage and inventory feed.

requirements.official_text: Utilize software inventory tools, when possible, throughout the enterprise to automate the discovery and documentation of installed software.

requirements.title: Allowlist Authorized Software
requirements.control_name: Inventory and Control of Software Assets
requirements.source_cadence: Reassess at least every six months.
requirements.guidance: Restrict execution/access to approved applications. Enforce application restrictions.

operating_guidance.client_provider_split: IT/provider manages inventory/enforcement; client approves business exceptions.
operating_guidance.establish: Define approved software and exception handling.
operating_guidance.operate: Enforce application restrictions.

requirements.official_text: Use technical controls, such as application allowlisting, to ensure that only authorized software can execute or be accessed. Reassess bi-annually, or more frequently.

requirements.title: Allowlist Authorized Libraries
requirements.control_name: Inventory and Control of Software Assets
requirements.source_cadence: Reassess at least every six months.
requirements.guidance: Prevent unapproved libraries loading. Enforce library controls; handle changes safely.

operating_guidance.client_provider_split: IT/provider manages inventory/enforcement; client approves business exceptions.
operating_guidance.establish: Define authorized libraries and deployment limitations.
operating_guidance.operate: Enforce library controls; handle changes safely.

requirements.official_text: Use technical controls to ensure that only authorized software libraries, such as specific .dll, .ocx,  and .so files, are allowed to load into a system process. Block unauthorized libraries from loading into a system process. Reassess bi-annually, or more frequently.

requirements.title: Allowlist Authorized Scripts
requirements.control_name: Inventory and Control of Software Assets
requirements.source_cadence: CIS says bi-annually or more frequently. Interpret as every six months, supported by the CAS six-month test; enforcement is ongoing.
requirements.guidance: Enforce execution of authorized scripts only and block others; reassess at least every six months.

operating_guidance.accountable_role: Responsible client team or provider (client to identify)
operating_guidance.client_provider_split: Client approves scope and exceptions; the responsible client team or provider performs the activity and supplies relevant records.
operating_guidance.establish: Identify script execution paths, including administrative tools, email and browser handling. Confirm authorized execution and blocked unauthorized execution using safe existing test results; check the latest reassessment date.
operating_guidance.operate: Enforce execution of authorized scripts only and block others; reassess at least every six months. CIS says bi-annually or more frequently. Interpret as every six months, supported by the CAS six-month test; enforcement is ongoing.
operating_guidance.dependencies: Safeguard 2.1: Establish and Maintain a Software Inventory Safeguard 4.1: Establish and Maintain a Secure Configuration Process

requirements.official_text: Use technical controls, such as digital signatures and version control, to ensure that only authorized scripts, such as specific .ps1, and .py files are allowed to execute. Block unauthorized scripts from executing. Reassess bi-annually, or more frequently.

requirements.title: Establish and Maintain a Data Management Process
requirements.guidance: Document data ownership, sensitivity, handling, retention and disposal.
requirements.official_text: Establish and maintain a documented data management process. In the process, address data sensitivity, data owner, handling of data, data retention limits, and disposal requirements, based on sensitivity and retention standards for the enterprise. Review and update documentation annually, or when significant enterprise changes occur that could impact this Safeguard.

requirements.title: Establish and Maintain a Data Inventory
requirements.guidance: Locate sensitive information and keep its inventory current.
requirements.official_text: Establish and maintain a data inventory based on the enterprise’s data management process. Inventory sensitive data, at a minimum. Review and update inventory annually, at a minimum, with a priority on sensitive data.

requirements.title: Configure Data Access Control Lists
requirements.guidance: Limit data permissions to justified business needs.
requirements.official_text: Configure data access control lists based on a user’s need to know. Apply data access control lists, also known as access permissions, to local and remote file systems, databases, and applications.

requirements.title: Enforce Data Retention
requirements.guidance: Apply documented minimum and maximum retention periods.
requirements.official_text: Retain data according to the enterprise’s documented data management process. Data retention must include both minimum and maximum timelines.

requirements.title: Securely Dispose of Data
requirements.guidance: Select disposal methods appropriate to information sensitivity.
requirements.official_text: Securely dispose of data as outlined in the enterprise’s documented data management process. Ensure the disposal process and method are commensurate with the data sensitivity.

requirements.title: Encrypt Data on End-User Devices
requirements.guidance: Protect sensitive endpoint information with device encryption.
requirements.official_text: Encrypt data on end-user devices containing sensitive data. Example implementations can include: Windows BitLocker®, Apple FileVault®, Linux® dm-crypt.

requirements.title: Establish and Maintain a Data Classification Scheme
requirements.guidance: Give information consistent sensitivity classifications. Apply classification in handling decisions.

operating_guidance.client_provider_split: Client determines sensitivity/handling; IT/provider implements protection and supplies coverage.
operating_guidance.establish: Agree classification criteria with data owners.
operating_guidance.operate: Apply classification in handling decisions.

requirements.official_text: Establish and maintain an overall data classification scheme for the enterprise. Enterprises may use labels, such as “Sensitive,” “Confidential,” and “Public,” and classify their data according to those labels. Review and update the classification scheme annually, or when significant enterprise changes occur that could impact this Safeguard.

requirements.title: Document Data Flows
requirements.guidance: Document internal and service-provider data flows using the enterprise data management process. Review and update the documentation annually and after significant relevant changes.

operating_guidance.client_provider_split: Client determines sensitivity/handling; IT/provider implements protection and supplies coverage.
operating_guidance.establish: Map material flows and external destinations.
operating_guidance.operate: Maintain flows through service changes.

requirements.official_text: Document data flows. Data flow documentation includes service provider data flows and should be based on the enterprise’s data management process. Review and update documentation annually, or when significant enterprise changes occur that could impact this Safeguard.

requirements.title: Encrypt Data on Removable Media
requirements.guidance: Protect removable-media contents with encryption. Enforce media encryption.

operating_guidance.client_provider_split: Client determines sensitivity/handling; IT/provider implements protection and supplies coverage.
operating_guidance.establish: Define permitted media and encryption arrangements.
operating_guidance.operate: Enforce media encryption.

requirements.official_text: Encrypt data on removable media.

requirements.title: Encrypt Sensitive Data in Transit
requirements.guidance: Protect sensitive information during transfer. Maintain encrypted transport.

operating_guidance.client_provider_split: Client determines sensitivity/handling; IT/provider implements protection and supplies coverage.
operating_guidance.establish: Identify sensitive flows and protected transports.
operating_guidance.operate: Maintain encrypted transport.

requirements.official_text: Encrypt sensitive data in transit. Example implementations can include: Transport Layer Security (TLS) and Open Secure Shell (OpenSSH).

requirements.title: Encrypt Sensitive Data at Rest
requirements.guidance: Protect stored sensitive server/application/database information. Maintain encryption coverage.

operating_guidance.client_provider_split: Client determines sensitivity/handling; IT/provider implements protection and supplies coverage.
operating_guidance.establish: Identify storage and encryption coverage; storage-layer protection suffices for the stated minimum.
operating_guidance.operate: Maintain encryption coverage.

requirements.official_text: Encrypt sensitive data at rest on servers, applications, and databases. Storage-layer encryption, also known as server-side encryption, meets the minimum requirement of this Safeguard. Additional encryption methods may include application-layer encryption, also known as client-side encryption, where access to the data storage device(s) does not permit access to the plain-text data.

requirements.title: Segment Data Processing and Storage Based on Sensitivity
requirements.guidance: Keep sensitive processing out of lower-trust environments. Enforce storage and processing separation.

operating_guidance.client_provider_split: Client determines sensitivity/handling; IT/provider implements protection and supplies coverage.
operating_guidance.establish: Define sensitivity boundaries and permitted processing locations.
operating_guidance.operate: Enforce storage and processing separation.

requirements.official_text: Segment data processing and storage based on the sensitivity of the data. Do not process sensitive data on enterprise assets intended for lower sensitivity data.

requirements.title: Deploy a Data Loss Prevention Solution
requirements.source_cadence: No fixed interval specified. The automated capability and inventory-update process must operate.
requirements.guidance: Use automated sensitive-data discovery across enterprise and provider assets, and update the data inventory.

operating_guidance.accountable_role: Responsible client team or provider (client to identify)
operating_guidance.client_provider_split: Client approves scope and exceptions; the responsible client team or provider performs the activity and supplies relevant records.
operating_guidance.establish: Confirm coverage of stored, processed and transmitted sensitive information, including remote-provider locations. Trace a detected data location to the inventory and investigate blind spots.
operating_guidance.operate: Use automated sensitive-data discovery across enterprise and provider assets, and update the data inventory. No fixed interval specified. The automated capability and inventory-update process must operate.
operating_guidance.dependencies: Safeguard 2.1: Establish and Maintain a Software Inventory Safeguard 3.2: Establish and Maintain a Data Inventory

requirements.official_text: Implement an automated tool, such as a host-based Data Loss Prevention (DLP) tool to identify all sensitive data stored, processed, or transmitted through enterprise assets, including those located onsite or at a remote service provider, and update the enterprise's  data inventory.

requirements.title: Log Sensitive Data Access
requirements.source_cadence: No fixed review interval specified. Logging must cover relevant access events as they occur.
requirements.guidance: Record access to sensitive data, including changes and disposal.

operating_guidance.accountable_role: Responsible client team or provider (client to identify)
operating_guidance.client_provider_split: Client approves scope and exceptions; the responsible client team or provider performs the activity and supplies relevant records.
operating_guidance.establish: Compare sensitive-data locations to enabled audit sources. Inspect representative access, modification and deletion records and identify locations or event types that are not recorded.
operating_guidance.operate: Record access to sensitive data, including changes and disposal. No fixed review interval specified. Logging must cover relevant access events as they occur.
operating_guidance.dependencies: Safeguard 1.1: Establish and Maintain Detailed Enterprise Asset Inventory Safeguard 2.1: Establish and Maintain a Software Inventory Safeguard 4.1: Establish and Maintain a Secure Configuration Process

requirements.official_text: Log sensitive data access, including modification and disposal.

requirements.title: Establish and Maintain a Secure Configuration Process
requirements.control_name: Secure Configuration of Enterprise Assets and Software
requirements.guidance: Document secure device and software configurations and maintain baselines.
requirements.official_text: Establish and maintain a documented secure configuration process for enterprise assets (end-user devices, including portable and mobile, non-computing/IoT devices, and servers) and software (operating systems and applications). Review and update documentation annually, or when significant enterprise changes occur that could impact this Safeguard.

requirements.title: Establish and Maintain a Secure Configuration Process for Network Infrastructure
requirements.control_name: Secure Configuration of Enterprise Assets and Software
requirements.guidance: Maintain documented secure network-device configurations.
requirements.official_text: Establish and maintain a documented secure configuration process for network devices. Review and update documentation annually, or when significant enterprise changes occur that could impact this Safeguard.

requirements.title: Configure Automatic Session Locking on Enterprise Assets
requirements.control_name: Secure Configuration of Enterprise Assets and Software
requirements.source_cadence: Inactivity: general OS ≤15 minutes; mobile ≤2 minutes
requirements.guidance: Enforce appropriate inactivity lock settings.
requirements.official_text: Configure automatic session locking on enterprise assets after a defined period of inactivity. For general purpose operating systems, the period must not exceed 15 minutes. For mobile end-user devices, the period must not exceed 2 minutes.

requirements.title: Implement and Manage a Firewall on Servers
requirements.control_name: Secure Configuration of Enterprise Assets and Software
requirements.guidance: Enable supported server firewall protections.
requirements.official_text: Implement and manage a firewall on servers, where supported. Example implementations include a virtual firewall, operating system firewall, or a third-party firewall agent.

requirements.title: Implement and Manage a Firewall on End-User Devices
requirements.control_name: Secure Configuration of Enterprise Assets and Software
requirements.guidance: Use default-deny endpoint firewall rules with justified exceptions.
requirements.official_text: Implement and manage a host-based firewall or port-filtering tool on end-user devices, with a default-deny rule that drops all traffic except those services and ports that are explicitly allowed.

requirements.title: Securely Manage Enterprise Assets and Software
requirements.control_name: Secure Configuration of Enterprise Assets and Software
requirements.guidance: Use secure administrative channels and controlled configuration changes.
requirements.official_text: Securely manage enterprise assets and software. Example implementations include managing configuration through version-controlled Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) and accessing administrative interfaces over secure network protocols, such as Secure Shell (SSH) and Hypertext Transfer Protocol Secure (HTTPS). Do not use insecure management protocols, such as Telnet (Teletype Network) and HTTP, unless operationally essential.

requirements.title: Manage Default Accounts on Enterprise Assets and Software
requirements.control_name: Secure Configuration of Enterprise Assets and Software
requirements.guidance: Disable or secure preconfigured accounts.
requirements.official_text: Manage default accounts on enterprise assets and software, such as root, administrator, and other pre-configured vendor accounts. Example implementations can include: disabling default accounts or making them unusable.

requirements.title: Uninstall or Disable Unnecessary Services on Enterprise Assets and Software
requirements.control_name: Secure Configuration of Enterprise Assets and Software
requirements.guidance: Remove unnecessary exposed functionality. Remove or disable unnecessary services.

operating_guidance.client_provider_split: Client approves baseline and exceptions; administrators/provider configure and report.
operating_guidance.establish: Identify required services and approved baselines.
operating_guidance.operate: Remove or disable unnecessary services.

requirements.official_text: Uninstall or disable unnecessary services on enterprise assets and software, such as an unused file sharing service, web application module, or service function.

requirements.title: Configure Trusted DNS Servers on Enterprise Assets
requirements.control_name: Secure Configuration of Enterprise Assets and Software
requirements.guidance: Use trustworthy infrastructure name resolution. Maintain trusted resolver settings.

operating_guidance.client_provider_split: Client approves baseline and exceptions; administrators/provider configure and report.
operating_guidance.establish: Agree approved DNS resolvers for network infrastructure.
operating_guidance.operate: Maintain trusted resolver settings.

requirements.official_text: Configure trusted DNS servers on network infrastructure. Example implementations include configuring network devices to use enterprise-controlled DNS servers and/or reputable externally accessible DNS servers.

requirements.title: Enforce Automatic Device Lockout on Portable End-User Devices
requirements.control_name: Secure Configuration of Enterprise Assets and Software
requirements.source_cadence: Where supported: at most 20 failed attempts on laptops; 10 on tablets/phones.
requirements.guidance: Limit repeated local authentication failures on portable devices. Enforce lockout thresholds.

operating_guidance.client_provider_split: Client approves baseline and exceptions; administrators/provider configure and report.
operating_guidance.establish: Define lockout configuration by device class.
operating_guidance.operate: Enforce lockout thresholds.

requirements.official_text: Enforce automatic device lockout following a predetermined threshold of local failed authentication attempts on portable end-user devices, where supported. For laptops, do not allow more than 20 failed authentication attempts; for tablets and smartphones, no more than 10 failed authentication attempts. Example implementations include Microsoft® InTune Device Lock and Apple® Configuration Profile maxFailedAttempts.

requirements.title: Enforce Remote Wipe Capability on Portable End-User Devices
requirements.control_name: Secure Configuration of Enterprise Assets and Software
requirements.source_cadence: Event: loss, theft or end of engagement are examples; no fixed interval.
requirements.guidance: Remove enterprise data remotely when appropriate. Maintain capability; execute on approved events.

operating_guidance.client_provider_split: Client approves baseline and exceptions; administrators/provider configure and report.
operating_guidance.establish: Establish authorized wipe process for enterprise-owned portable devices.
operating_guidance.operate: Maintain capability; execute on approved events.

requirements.official_text: Remotely wipe enterprise data from enterprise-owned portable end-user devices when deemed appropriate such as lost or stolen devices, or when an individual no longer supports the enterprise.

requirements.title: Separate Enterprise Workspaces on Mobile End-User Devices
requirements.control_name: Secure Configuration of Enterprise Assets and Software
requirements.source_cadence: No fixed interval specified; maintain the separation on supported devices.
requirements.guidance: Separate enterprise and personal workspaces on mobile devices wherever supported.

operating_guidance.accountable_role: Responsible client team or provider (client to identify)
operating_guidance.client_provider_split: Client approves scope and exceptions; the responsible client team or provider performs the activity and supplies relevant records.
operating_guidance.establish: Establish the supported mobile population, examine assigned profiles and confirm enterprise applications/data are separated from personal use. Record unsupported-device conditions without treating the whole safeguard as excluded.
operating_guidance.operate: Separate enterprise and personal workspaces on mobile devices wherever supported. No fixed interval specified; maintain the separation on supported devices.
operating_guidance.dependencies: Safeguard 1.1: Establish and Maintain Detailed Enterprise Asset Inventory Safeguard 2.1: Establish and Maintain a Software Inventory Safeguard 4.1: Establish and Maintain a Secure Configuration Process

requirements.official_text: Ensure separate enterprise workspaces are used on mobile end-user devices, where supported. Example implementations include using an Apple® Configuration Profile or Android™ Work Profile to separate enterprise applications and data from personal applications and data.

requirements.title: Establish and Maintain an Inventory of Accounts
requirements.guidance: Inventory accounts and verify continuing authorization.
requirements.official_text: Establish and maintain an inventory of all accounts managed in the enterprise. The inventory must at a minimum include user, administrator accounts, and service accounts. The inventory, at a minimum, should contain the person’s name, username, start/stop dates, and department. Validate that all active accounts are authorized, on a recurring schedule at a minimum quarterly, or more frequently.

requirements.title: Use Unique Passwords
requirements.guidance: Use distinct passwords; source guidance distinguishes MFA and non-MFA accounts.
requirements.official_text: Use unique passwords for all enterprise assets. Best practice implementation includes, at a minimum, an 8-character password for accounts using Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) and a 14-character password for accounts not using MFA.

requirements.title: Disable Dormant Accounts
requirements.source_cadence: After 45 days of inactivity, where supported
requirements.guidance: Detect inactive accounts and disable or remove them.
requirements.official_text: Delete or disable any dormant accounts after a period of 45 days of inactivity, where supported.

requirements.title: Restrict Administrator Privileges to Dedicated Administrator Accounts
requirements.guidance: Separate privileged administration from ordinary computing.
requirements.official_text: Restrict administrator privileges to dedicated administrator accounts on enterprise assets. Conduct general computing activities, such as internet browsing, email, and productivity suite use, from the user’s primary, non-privileged account.

requirements.title: Establish and Maintain an Inventory of Service Accounts
requirements.guidance: Keep service-account purpose and ownership accountable. Maintain inventory through account changes.

operating_guidance.client_provider_split: Client authorizes accounts; identity operator/provider maintains controls and inventories.
operating_guidance.establish: Identify service accounts, department owners, purpose and review dates.
operating_guidance.operate: Maintain inventory through account changes. Service-account records identify the responsible department, owner, purpose and review date; authorization reviews occur at least quarterly.

requirements.official_text: Establish and maintain an inventory of service accounts. The inventory, at a minimum, must contain department owner, review date, and purpose. Perform service account reviews to validate that all active accounts are authorized, on a recurring schedule at a minimum quarterly, or more frequently.

requirements.title: Centralize Account Management
requirements.guidance: Consolidate account administration. Operate centralized account management.

operating_guidance.client_provider_split: Client authorizes accounts; identity operator/provider maintains controls and inventories.
operating_guidance.establish: Identify directory/identity authority and exceptions.
operating_guidance.operate: Operate centralized account management.

requirements.official_text: Centralize account management through a directory or identity service.

requirements.title: Establish an Access Granting Process
requirements.guidance: Document and follow access approval and provisioning.
requirements.official_text: Establish and follow a documented process, preferably automated, for granting access to enterprise assets upon new hire or role change of a user.

requirements.title: Establish an Access Revoking Process
requirements.source_cadence: Immediately at termination, revocation or role change
requirements.guidance: Revoke access immediately on termination, rights revocation or role change; retain disabled accounts when needed to preserve audit history.
requirements.official_text: Establish and follow a process, preferably automated, for revoking access to enterprise assets, through disabling accounts immediately upon termination, rights revocation, or role change of a user. Disabling accounts, instead of deleting accounts, may be necessary to preserve audit trails.

requirements.title: Require MFA for Externally-Exposed Applications
requirements.guidance: Enforce supported MFA for externally accessible applications.
requirements.official_text: Require all externally-exposed enterprise or third-party applications to enforce MFA, where supported. Enforcing MFA through a directory service or SSO provider is a satisfactory implementation of this Safeguard.

requirements.title: Require MFA for Remote Network Access
requirements.guidance: Protect remote network entry with MFA.
requirements.official_text: Require MFA for remote network access.

requirements.title: Require MFA for Administrative Access
requirements.guidance: Apply supported MFA to privileged accounts.
requirements.official_text: Require MFA for all administrative access accounts, where supported, on all enterprise assets, whether managed on-site or through a service provider.

requirements.title: Establish and Maintain an Inventory of Authentication and Authorization Systems
requirements.guidance: Identify all authentication/authorization systems. Maintain system inventory.

operating_guidance.client_provider_split: HR/business owners trigger changes; identity operator/provider executes and documents.
operating_guidance.establish: Inventory internal and provider-hosted identity systems.
operating_guidance.operate: Maintain system inventory.

requirements.official_text: Establish and maintain an inventory of the enterprise’s authentication and authorization systems, including those hosted on-site or at a remote service provider. Review and update the inventory, at a minimum, annually, or more frequently.

requirements.title: Centralize Access Control
requirements.source_cadence: No numeric interval specified; where supported.
requirements.guidance: Consolidate supported access enforcement. Operate centralized access control.

operating_guidance.client_provider_split: HR/business owners trigger changes; identity operator/provider executes and documents.
operating_guidance.establish: Define directory/SSO coverage and limitations.
operating_guidance.operate: Operate centralized access control.

requirements.official_text: Centralize access control for all enterprise assets through a directory service or SSO provider, where supported.

requirements.title: Define and Maintain Role-Based Access Control
requirements.source_cadence: Access-control review at least annually or more often. Role definitions and rights are maintained.
requirements.guidance: Document necessary rights by role; review asset privileges for authorization at least annually.

operating_guidance.accountable_role: Responsible client team or provider (client to identify)
operating_guidance.client_provider_split: Client approves scope and exceptions; the responsible client team or provider performs the activity and supplies relevant records.
operating_guidance.establish: Compare job duties, role definitions and actual asset privileges. Confirm reviews cover all privileges, including privileged and service access where relevant; investigate excessive and unmapped rights.
operating_guidance.operate: Document necessary rights by role; review asset privileges for authorization at least annually. Access-control review at least annually or more often. Role definitions and rights are maintained.
operating_guidance.dependencies: Safeguard 5.1: Establish and Maintain an Inventory of Accounts

requirements.official_text: Define and maintain role-based access control, through determining and documenting the access rights necessary for each role within the enterprise to successfully carry out its assigned duties. Perform access control reviews of enterprise assets to validate that all privileges are authorized, on a recurring schedule at a minimum annually, or more frequently.

requirements.title: Establish and Maintain a Vulnerability Management Process
requirements.guidance: Document how vulnerabilities are identified and managed.
requirements.official_text: Establish and maintain a documented vulnerability management process for enterprise assets. Review and update documentation annually, or when significant enterprise changes occur that could impact this Safeguard.

requirements.title: Establish and Maintain a Remediation Process
requirements.guidance: Review a documented risk-prioritized remediation process.
requirements.official_text: Establish and maintain a risk-based remediation strategy documented in a remediation process, with monthly, or more frequent, reviews.

requirements.title: Perform Automated Operating System Patch Management
requirements.guidance: Automate operating-system updates and manage failed deployments.
requirements.official_text: Perform operating system updates on enterprise assets through automated patch management on a monthly, or more frequent, basis.

requirements.title: Perform Automated Application Patch Management
requirements.guidance: Automate application updates and manage failed deployments.
requirements.official_text: Perform application updates on enterprise assets through automated patch management on a monthly, or more frequent, basis.

requirements.title: Perform Automated Vulnerability Scans of Internal Enterprise Assets
requirements.source_cadence: At least quarterly; authenticated and unauthenticated scans.
requirements.guidance: Find internal vulnerabilities with both scan perspectives. Run scans and route results.

operating_guidance.client_provider_split: Client prioritizes risk; IT/provider scans, patches and remediates.
operating_guidance.establish: Define internal scope, credentials and authorized scanning windows.
operating_guidance.operate: Run scans and route results.

requirements.official_text: Perform automated vulnerability scans of internal enterprise assets on a quarterly, or more frequent, basis. Conduct both authenticated and unauthenticated scans.

requirements.title: Perform Automated Vulnerability Scans of Externally-Exposed Enterprise Assets
requirements.guidance: Find weaknesses in externally exposed assets. Run external scans and route results.

operating_guidance.client_provider_split: Client prioritizes risk; IT/provider scans, patches and remediates.
operating_guidance.establish: Identify external attack surface and scanning owner.
operating_guidance.operate: Run external scans and route results.

requirements.official_text: Perform automated vulnerability scans of externally-exposed enterprise assets. Perform scans on a monthly, or more frequent, basis.

requirements.title: Remediate Detected Vulnerabilities
requirements.source_cadence: Remediation at least monthly, following the remediation process.
requirements.guidance: Resolve detected software weaknesses systematically. Remediate and validate outcomes.

operating_guidance.client_provider_split: Client prioritizes risk; IT/provider scans, patches and remediates.
operating_guidance.establish: Define triage and remediation accountability.
operating_guidance.operate: Remediate and validate outcomes.

requirements.official_text: Remediate detected vulnerabilities in software through processes and tooling on a monthly, or more frequent, basis, based on the remediation process.

requirements.title: Establish and Maintain an Audit Log Management Process
requirements.guidance: Document log collection, retention and review expectations.
requirements.official_text: Establish and maintain a documented audit log management process that defines the enterprise’s logging requirements. At a minimum, address the collection, review, and retention of audit logs for enterprise assets. Review and update documentation annually, or when significant enterprise changes occur that could impact this Safeguard.

requirements.title: Collect Audit Logs
requirements.source_cadence: As defined by the logging process
requirements.guidance: Enable required audit events across assets.
requirements.official_text: Collect audit logs. Ensure that logging, per the enterprise’s audit log management process, has been enabled across enterprise assets.

requirements.title: Ensure Adequate Audit Log Storage
requirements.source_cadence: As defined by the logging process
requirements.guidance: Size and manage storage to meet documented logging needs.
requirements.official_text: Ensure that logging destinations maintain adequate storage to comply with the enterprise’s audit log management process.

requirements.title: Standardize Time Synchronization
requirements.source_cadence: No numeric interval; at least two synchronized sources where supported.
requirements.guidance: Make event times comparable. Operate time synchronization.

operating_guidance.client_provider_split: Client sets scope and escalation; internal team/provider collects and reviews logs.
operating_guidance.establish: Define time sources and supported asset coverage.
operating_guidance.operate: Operate time synchronization.

requirements.official_text: Standardize time synchronization. Configure at least two synchronized time sources across enterprise assets, where supported.

requirements.title: Collect Detailed Audit Logs
requirements.guidance: Configure detailed audit logs on enterprise assets containing sensitive data, including the event source, date, username, timestamp, source and destination addresses, and other useful investigation details.

operating_guidance.client_provider_split: Client sets scope and escalation; internal team/provider collects and reviews logs.
operating_guidance.establish: Identify sensitive-data assets and define the required detailed logging fields.
operating_guidance.operate: Collect the event source, date, username, timestamp, source and destination addresses, and other useful investigation details. Identify missing required fields as coverage gaps; availability alone does not remove the requirement.

requirements.official_text: Configure detailed audit logging for enterprise assets containing sensitive data. Include event source, date, username, timestamp, source addresses, destination addresses, and other useful elements that could assist in a forensic investigation.

requirements.title: Collect DNS Query Audit Logs
requirements.source_cadence: No numeric interval; where appropriate and supported.
requirements.guidance: Preserve relevant DNS-query observations. Collect DNS query events.

operating_guidance.client_provider_split: Client sets scope and escalation; internal team/provider collects and reviews logs.
operating_guidance.establish: Identify DNS logging coverage and limitations.
operating_guidance.operate: Collect DNS query events.

requirements.official_text: Collect DNS query audit logs on enterprise assets, where appropriate and supported.

requirements.title: Collect URL Request Audit Logs
requirements.source_cadence: No numeric interval; where appropriate and supported.
requirements.guidance: Preserve relevant web-request observations. Collect URL request events.

operating_guidance.client_provider_split: Client sets scope and escalation; internal team/provider collects and reviews logs.
operating_guidance.establish: Identify URL logging coverage and limitations.
operating_guidance.operate: Collect URL request events.

requirements.official_text: Collect URL request audit logs on enterprise assets, where appropriate and supported.

requirements.title: Collect Command-Line Audit Logs
requirements.guidance: Make command execution traceable. Collect command-line events.

operating_guidance.client_provider_split: Client sets scope and escalation; internal team/provider collects and reviews logs.
operating_guidance.establish: Define command-line logging sources.
operating_guidance.operate: Collect command-line events.

requirements.official_text: Collect command-line audit logs. Example implementations include collecting audit logs from PowerShell®, BASH™, and remote administrative terminals.

requirements.title: Centralize Audit Logs
requirements.source_cadence: No numeric interval; centralize to the extent possible.
requirements.guidance: Make logs jointly accessible for investigation. Operate centralized collection/retention.

operating_guidance.client_provider_split: Client sets scope and escalation; internal team/provider collects and reviews logs.
operating_guidance.establish: Define central destinations and exceptions.
operating_guidance.operate: Operate centralized collection/retention.

requirements.official_text: Centralize, to the extent possible, audit log collection and retention across enterprise assets in accordance with the documented audit log management process. Example implementations include leveraging a SIEM tool to centralize multiple log sources.

requirements.title: Retain Audit Logs
requirements.guidance: Keep adequate historical audit events. Retain events throughout the required window.

operating_guidance.client_provider_split: Client sets scope and escalation; internal team/provider collects and reviews logs.
operating_guidance.establish: Configure retention and capacity together.
operating_guidance.operate: Retain events throughout the required window.

requirements.official_text: Retain audit logs across enterprise assets for a minimum of 90 days.

requirements.title: Conduct Audit Log Reviews
requirements.guidance: Detect suspicious behavior through log examination. Review logs and investigate anomalies.

operating_guidance.client_provider_split: Client sets scope and escalation; internal team/provider collects and reviews logs.
operating_guidance.establish: Assign log-review coverage, escalation and substitute coverage.
operating_guidance.operate: Review logs and investigate anomalies.

requirements.official_text: Conduct reviews of audit logs to detect anomalies or abnormal events that could indicate a potential threat. Conduct reviews on a weekly, or more frequent, basis.

requirements.title: Collect Service Provider Logs
requirements.source_cadence: No fixed collection or human-review interval specified here; collect on an ongoing basis where supported.
requirements.guidance: Obtain service-provider logs wherever the provider supports them.

operating_guidance.accountable_role: Responsible client team or provider (client to identify)
operating_guidance.client_provider_split: Client approves scope and exceptions; the responsible client team or provider performs the activity and supplies relevant records.
operating_guidance.establish: Match the provider inventory to available log interfaces and actual received records. Distinguish unavailable provider functionality from supported logging that has not been configured.
operating_guidance.operate: Obtain service-provider logs wherever the provider supports them. No fixed collection or human-review interval specified here; collect on an ongoing basis where supported.
operating_guidance.dependencies: Safeguard 4.1: Establish and Maintain a Secure Configuration Process Safeguard 15.1: Establish and Maintain an Inventory of Service Providers

requirements.official_text: Collect service provider logs, where supported. Example implementations include collecting authentication and authorization events, data creation and disposal events, and user management events.

requirements.title: Ensure Use of Only Fully Supported Browsers and Email Clients
requirements.guidance: Restrict browser and email software to current supported releases.
requirements.official_text: Ensure only fully supported browsers and email clients are allowed to execute in the enterprise, only using the latest version of browsers and email clients provided through the vendor.

requirements.title: Use DNS Filtering Services
requirements.guidance: Block known malicious domains for local and remote endpoints.
requirements.official_text: Use DNS filtering services on all end-user devices, including remote and on-premises assets, to block access to known malicious domains.

requirements.title: Maintain and Enforce Network-Based URL Filters
requirements.guidance: Limit risky web destinations through network controls. Enforce and update URL filtering.

operating_guidance.client_provider_split: Client sets acceptable use; IT/mail provider configures protections.
operating_guidance.establish: Define network URL restrictions for all enterprise assets.
operating_guidance.operate: Enforce and update URL filtering.

requirements.official_text: Enforce and update network-based URL filters to limit an enterprise asset from connecting to potentially malicious or unapproved websites. Example implementations include category-based filtering, reputation-based filtering, or through the use of block lists. Enforce filters for all enterprise assets.

requirements.title: Restrict Unnecessary or Unauthorized Browser and Email Client Extensions
requirements.guidance: Uninstall or disable unauthorized or unnecessary browser and email-client plugins, extensions and add-on applications.

operating_guidance.client_provider_split: Client sets acceptable use; IT/mail provider configures protections.
operating_guidance.establish: Identify authorized and necessary browser and email-client plugins, extensions and add-on applications across the covered assets.
operating_guidance.operate: Uninstall or disable unauthorized or unnecessary browser and email-client plugins, extensions and add-on applications.

requirements.official_text: Restrict, either through uninstalling or disabling, any unauthorized or unnecessary browser or email client plugins, extensions, and add-on applications.

requirements.title: Implement DMARC
requirements.guidance: Authenticate domain email to reduce spoofing. Operate domain authentication.

operating_guidance.client_provider_split: Client sets acceptable use; IT/mail provider configures protections.
operating_guidance.establish: Establish SPF/DKIM before DMARC policy and verification.
operating_guidance.operate: Operate domain authentication.

requirements.official_text: To lower the chance of spoofed or modified emails from valid domains, implement DMARC policy and verification, starting with implementing the Sender Policy Framework (SPF) and the DomainKeys Identified Mail (DKIM) standards.

requirements.title: Block Unnecessary File Types
requirements.guidance: Prevent unwanted email attachment types entering. Enforce email file-type blocking.

operating_guidance.client_provider_split: Client sets acceptable use; IT/mail provider configures protections.
operating_guidance.establish: Agree unnecessary file types and gateway coverage.
operating_guidance.operate: Enforce email file-type blocking.

requirements.official_text: Block unnecessary file types attempting to enter the enterprise’s email gateway.

requirements.title: Deploy and Maintain Email Server Anti-Malware Protections
requirements.source_cadence: No fixed interval specified. Protection is maintained in operation.
requirements.guidance: Operate and maintain anti-malware protection for email servers.

operating_guidance.accountable_role: Responsible client team or provider (client to identify)
operating_guidance.client_provider_split: Client approves scope and exceptions; the responsible client team or provider performs the activity and supplies relevant records.
operating_guidance.establish: Include hosted email responsibility arrangements. Inspect enabled protection and existing detection/blocking results; distinguish mail-client protection from coverage of the email service.
operating_guidance.operate: Operate and maintain anti-malware protection for email servers. No fixed interval specified. Protection is maintained in operation.
operating_guidance.dependencies: Safeguard 1.1: Establish and Maintain Detailed Enterprise Asset Inventory Safeguard 4.1: Establish and Maintain a Secure Configuration Process

requirements.official_text: Deploy and maintain email server anti-malware protections, such as attachment scanning and/or sandboxing.

requirements.title: Deploy and Maintain Anti-Malware Software
requirements.guidance: Maintain endpoint malware protection.
requirements.official_text: Deploy and maintain anti-malware software on all enterprise assets.

requirements.title: Configure Automatic Anti-Malware Signature Updates
requirements.guidance: Keep malware detection signatures automatically updated.
requirements.official_text: Configure automatic updates for anti-malware signature files on all enterprise assets.

requirements.title: Disable Autorun and Autoplay for Removable Media
requirements.guidance: Prevent removable media from executing automatically.
requirements.official_text: Disable autorun and autoplay auto-execute functionality for removable media.

requirements.title: Configure Automatic Anti-Malware Scanning of Removable Media
requirements.source_cadence: Automatic scanning on media use; no calendar interval.
requirements.guidance: Inspect removable media automatically. Run automatic media malware scans.

operating_guidance.client_provider_split: IT/provider maintains protection; client approves coverage exceptions.
operating_guidance.establish: Configure scanning coverage.
operating_guidance.operate: Run automatic media malware scans.

requirements.official_text: Configure anti-malware software to automatically scan removable media.

requirements.title: Enable Anti-Exploitation Features
requirements.guidance: Use available exploitation resistance. Maintain enabled anti-exploitation features.

operating_guidance.client_provider_split: IT/provider maintains protection; client approves coverage exceptions.
operating_guidance.establish: Identify supported asset/software protections.
operating_guidance.operate: Maintain enabled anti-exploitation features.

requirements.official_text: Enable anti-exploitation features on enterprise assets and software, where possible, such as Microsoft® Data Execution Prevention (DEP), Windows® Defender Exploit Guard (WDEG), or Apple® System Integrity Protection (SIP) and Gatekeeper™.

requirements.title: Centrally Manage Anti-Malware Software
requirements.guidance: Coordinate malware protection centrally. Maintain centralized policy and coverage.

operating_guidance.client_provider_split: IT/provider maintains protection; client approves coverage exceptions.
operating_guidance.establish: Define central management and asset enrollment.
operating_guidance.operate: Maintain centralized policy and coverage.

requirements.official_text: Centrally manage anti-malware software.

requirements.title: Use Behavior-Based Anti-Malware Software
requirements.guidance: Detect malware by behavior. Operate behavior-based malware protection.

operating_guidance.client_provider_split: IT/provider maintains protection; client approves coverage exceptions.
operating_guidance.establish: Establish behavior-detection coverage.
operating_guidance.operate: Operate behavior-based malware protection.

requirements.official_text: Use behavior-based anti-malware software.

requirements.title: Establish and Maintain a Data Recovery Process
requirements.guidance: Document recovery scope, priorities, backup procedures and protection.
requirements.official_text:
Establish and maintain a documented data recovery process. In the process, address the scope of data recovery activities, 
recovery prioritization, and the security of backup data. Review and update documentation annually, or when significant enterprise changes occur that could impact this Safeguard.

requirements.title: Perform Automated Backups
requirements.source_cadence: Weekly or more often, based on sensitivity
requirements.guidance: Automate in-scope backups and investigate failures.
requirements.official_text: Perform automated backups of in-scope enterprise assets. Run backups weekly, or more frequently, based on the sensitivity of the data.

requirements.title: Protect Recovery Data
requirements.guidance: Protect backups consistently with original-data sensitivity.
requirements.official_text: Protect recovery data with equivalent controls to the original data. Reference encryption or data separation, based on requirements.

requirements.title: Establish and Maintain an Isolated Instance of Recovery Data
requirements.guidance: Maintain a backup copy isolated from primary-system compromise.
requirements.official_text: Establish and maintain an isolated instance of recovery data. Example implementations include, version controlling backup destinations through offline, cloud, or off-site systems or services.

requirements.title: Test Data Recovery
requirements.guidance: Demonstrate sampled recovery actually works. Execute restore tests and resolve failures.

operating_guidance.client_provider_split: Client sets recovery priorities; IT/provider operates backups and tests restoration.
operating_guidance.establish: Select representative recovery samples and success criteria.
operating_guidance.operate: Execute restore tests and resolve failures.

requirements.official_text: Test backup recovery quarterly, or more frequently, for a sampling of in-scope enterprise assets.

requirements.title: Ensure Network Infrastructure is Up-to-Date
requirements.guidance: Verify network software support and maintain current infrastructure.
requirements.official_text: Ensure network infrastructure is kept up-to-date. Example implementations include running the latest stable release of software and/or using currently supported network-as-a-service (NaaS) offerings. Review software versions monthly, or more frequently, to verify software support.

requirements.title: Establish and Maintain a Secure Network Architecture
requirements.guidance: Design and maintain secure network architecture addressing segmentation, least privilege and availability. Documentation supports the architecture but does not replace policy and design components.

operating_guidance.client_provider_split: Client approves boundaries; network operator/provider implements and documents.
operating_guidance.establish: Define architecture and security boundaries.
operating_guidance.operate: Maintain implemented network architecture.

requirements.official_text: Design and maintain a secure network architecture. A secure network architecture must address segmentation, least privilege, and availability, at a minimum. Example implementations will not solely include documentation, but also policy and design components.

requirements.title: Securely Manage Network Infrastructure
requirements.guidance: Protect network administration. Use secure infrastructure management.

operating_guidance.client_provider_split: Client approves boundaries; network operator/provider implements and documents.
operating_guidance.establish: Define secure administrative methods.
operating_guidance.operate: Use secure infrastructure management.

requirements.official_text: Securely manage network infrastructure. Example implementations include version-controlled Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC), and the use of secure network protocols, such as SSH and HTTPS.

requirements.title: Establish and Maintain Architecture Diagram(s)
requirements.guidance: Keep network architecture understandable and current. Maintain documentation with network changes.

operating_guidance.client_provider_split: Client approves boundaries; network operator/provider implements and documents.
operating_guidance.establish: Establish diagrams or equivalent system documentation.
operating_guidance.operate: Maintain documentation with network changes.

requirements.official_text: Establish and maintain architecture diagram(s) and/or other network system documentation. Review and update documentation annually, or when significant enterprise changes occur that could impact this Safeguard.

requirements.title: Centralize Network Authentication, Authorization, and Auditing (AAA)
requirements.guidance: Consolidate network identity, permissions and audit. Operate centralized network AAA.

operating_guidance.client_provider_split: Client approves boundaries; network operator/provider implements and documents.
operating_guidance.establish: Define centralized AAA coverage.
operating_guidance.operate: Operate centralized network AAA.

requirements.official_text: Centralize network AAA.

requirements.title: Use of Secure Network Management and Communication Protocols
requirements.guidance: Protect network management and communications. Maintain secure protocol configurations.

operating_guidance.client_provider_split: Client approves boundaries; network operator/provider implements and documents.
operating_guidance.establish: Select secure protocols for applicable network services.
operating_guidance.operate: Maintain secure protocol configurations.

requirements.official_text: Use secure network management and communication protocols (e.g., 802.1X, Wi-Fi Protected Access 2 (WPA2) Enterprise or greater).

requirements.title: Ensure Remote Devices Utilize a VPN and are Connecting to an Enterprise's AAA Infrastructure
requirements.guidance: Require users to authenticate to enterprise-managed VPN and authentication services before accessing enterprise resources on end-user devices.

operating_guidance.client_provider_split: Client approves boundaries; network operator/provider implements and documents.
operating_guidance.establish: Identify end-user device access paths and enterprise-managed VPN and authentication services.
operating_guidance.operate: Require VPN and authentication before resource access.

requirements.official_text: Require users to authenticate to enterprise-managed VPN and authentication services prior to accessing enterprise resources on end-user devices.

requirements.title: Establish and Maintain Dedicated Computing Resources for All Administrative Work
requirements.source_cadence: No fixed interval specified; the restrictions apply during administrative work.
requirements.guidance: Use physically or logically dedicated administrative computing resources, segmented from the primary network and without internet access.

operating_guidance.accountable_role: Responsible client team or provider (client to identify)
operating_guidance.client_provider_split: Client approves scope and exceptions; the responsible client team or provider performs the activity and supplies relevant records.
operating_guidance.establish: Identify all administrative tasks and the resources used for them. Confirm network separation and denied internet access using existing configuration/test records, including remote administrative routes.
operating_guidance.operate: Use physically or logically dedicated administrative computing resources, segmented from the primary network and without internet access. No fixed interval specified; the restrictions apply during administrative work.
operating_guidance.dependencies: Safeguard 1.1: Establish and Maintain Detailed Enterprise Asset Inventory Safeguard 4.2: Establish and Maintain a Secure Configuration Process for Network Infrastructure

requirements.official_text: Establish and maintain dedicated computing resources, either physically or logically separated, for all administrative tasks or tasks requiring administrative access. The computing resources should be segmented from the enterprise's primary network and not be allowed internet access.

requirements.title: Centralize Security Event Alerting
requirements.guidance: Correlate security events into actionable alerts. Operate correlated security alerting.

operating_guidance.client_provider_split: Client owns response decisions; network/SOC/provider operates detection and escalates.
operating_guidance.establish: Define correlation, alert ownership and escalation; equivalent log analytics can satisfy the outcome.
operating_guidance.operate: Operate correlated security alerting.

requirements.official_text: Centralize security event alerting across enterprise assets for log correlation and analysis. Best practice implementation requires the use of a SIEM, which includes vendor-defined event correlation alerts. A log analytics platform configured with security-relevant correlation alerts also satisfies this Safeguard.

requirements.title: Deploy a Host-Based Intrusion Detection Solution
requirements.guidance: Detect intrusions on supported/appropriate hosts. Operate host intrusion detection.

operating_guidance.client_provider_split: Client owns response decisions; network/SOC/provider operates detection and escalates.
operating_guidance.establish: Define host detection coverage and limitations.
operating_guidance.operate: Operate host intrusion detection.

requirements.official_text: Deploy a host-based intrusion detection solution on enterprise assets, where appropriate and/or supported.

requirements.title: Deploy a Network Intrusion Detection Solution
requirements.guidance: Detect network intrusions where appropriate. Operate network intrusion detection.

operating_guidance.client_provider_split: Client owns response decisions; network/SOC/provider operates detection and escalates.
operating_guidance.establish: Select observation points or equivalent cloud capability.
operating_guidance.operate: Operate network intrusion detection.

requirements.official_text: Deploy a network intrusion detection solution on enterprise assets, where appropriate. Example implementations include the use of a Network Intrusion Detection System (NIDS) or equivalent cloud service provider (CSP) service.

requirements.title: Perform Traffic Filtering Between Network Segments
requirements.source_cadence: No numeric interval specified; where appropriate.
requirements.guidance: Control traffic crossing network boundaries. Enforce boundary filtering.

operating_guidance.client_provider_split: Client owns response decisions; network/SOC/provider operates detection and escalates.
operating_guidance.establish: Define permitted inter-segment flows.
operating_guidance.operate: Enforce boundary filtering.

requirements.official_text: Perform traffic filtering between network segments, where appropriate.

requirements.title: Manage Access Control for Remote Assets
requirements.source_cadence: On remote connection; no numeric interval.
requirements.guidance: Condition remote access on asset security posture. Apply posture-based access decisions.

operating_guidance.client_provider_split: Client owns response decisions; network/SOC/provider operates detection and escalates.
operating_guidance.establish: Define checks for malware protection, configuration and patch currency.
operating_guidance.operate: Apply posture-based access decisions.

requirements.official_text: Manage access control for assets remotely connecting to enterprise resources. Determine amount of access to enterprise resources based on: up-to-date anti-malware software installed, configuration compliance with the enterprise’s secure configuration process, and ensuring the operating system and applications are up-to-date.

requirements.title: Collect Network Traffic Flow Logs
requirements.guidance: Make network flows available for review/alerts. Collect network flow or traffic records.

operating_guidance.client_provider_split: Client owns response decisions; network/SOC/provider operates detection and escalates.
operating_guidance.establish: Identify flow/traffic collection coverage and destinations.
operating_guidance.operate: Collect network flow or traffic records.

requirements.official_text: Collect network traffic flow logs and/or network traffic to review and alert upon from network devices.

requirements.title: Deploy a Host-Based Intrusion Prevention Solution
requirements.source_cadence: No fixed interval specified; prevention operates on applicable assets.
requirements.guidance: Provide host intrusion prevention where appropriate and/or supported.

operating_guidance.accountable_role: Responsible client team or provider (client to identify)
operating_guidance.client_provider_split: Client approves scope and exceptions; the responsible client team or provider performs the activity and supplies relevant records.
operating_guidance.establish: Confirm prevention capability and enabled mode, identify coverage gaps, and document support/appropriateness decisions. Distinguish detection-only telemetry from prevention.
operating_guidance.operate: Provide host intrusion prevention where appropriate and/or supported. No fixed interval specified; prevention operates on applicable assets.
operating_guidance.dependencies: Safeguard 1.1: Establish and Maintain Detailed Enterprise Asset Inventory Safeguard 2.1: Establish and Maintain a Software Inventory

requirements.official_text: Deploy a host-based intrusion prevention solution on enterprise assets, where appropriate and/or supported. Example implementations include use of an Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) client or host-based IPS agent.

requirements.title: Deploy a Network Intrusion Prevention Solution
requirements.source_cadence: No fixed interval specified; prevention operates on relevant network paths.
requirements.guidance: Provide network intrusion prevention where appropriate.

operating_guidance.accountable_role: Responsible client team or provider (client to identify)
operating_guidance.client_provider_split: Client approves scope and exceptions; the responsible client team or provider performs the activity and supplies relevant records.
operating_guidance.establish: Map relevant traffic paths to prevention controls and confirm blocking mode. Review uncovered or bypass routes and the rationale for where prevention is appropriate.
operating_guidance.operate: Provide network intrusion prevention where appropriate. No fixed interval specified; prevention operates on relevant network paths.
operating_guidance.dependencies: Safeguard 1.1: Establish and Maintain Detailed Enterprise Asset Inventory Safeguard 12.4: Establish and Maintain Architecture Diagram(s)

requirements.official_text: Deploy a network intrusion prevention solution, where appropriate. Example implementations include the use of a Network Intrusion Prevention System (NIPS) or equivalent CSP service.

requirements.title: Deploy Port-Level Access Control
requirements.source_cadence: No fixed interval specified; enforce when network access is attempted.
requirements.guidance: Enforce port-level network access using 802.1X or a similar authentication-based approach.

operating_guidance.accountable_role: Responsible client team or provider (client to identify)
operating_guidance.client_provider_split: Client approves scope and exceptions; the responsible client team or provider performs the activity and supplies relevant records.
operating_guidance.establish: Confirm which access ports are controlled and how devices/users authenticate. Examine existing authorized and unauthorized access test results and bypass arrangements.
operating_guidance.operate: Enforce port-level network access using 802.1X or a similar authentication-based approach. No fixed interval specified; enforce when network access is attempted.
operating_guidance.dependencies: Safeguard 1.1: Establish and Maintain Detailed Enterprise Asset Inventory

requirements.official_text: Deploy port-level access control. Port-level access control utilizes 802.1x, or similar network access control protocols, such as certificates, and may incorporate user and/or device authentication.

requirements.title: Perform Application Layer Filtering
requirements.source_cadence: No fixed interval specified; filtering operates on relevant traffic.
requirements.guidance: Filter network traffic at the application layer.

operating_guidance.accountable_role: Responsible client team or provider (client to identify)
operating_guidance.client_provider_split: Client approves scope and exceptions; the responsible client team or provider performs the activity and supplies relevant records.
operating_guidance.establish: Identify application-aware filtering points, relevant traffic paths and enabled policies. Review a representative permitted and blocked application request from existing records.
operating_guidance.operate: Filter network traffic at the application layer. No fixed interval specified; filtering operates on relevant traffic.
operating_guidance.dependencies: Safeguard 1.1: Establish and Maintain Detailed Enterprise Asset Inventory Safeguard 2.1: Establish and Maintain a Software Inventory

requirements.official_text: Perform application layer filtering. Example implementations include a filtering proxy, application layer firewall, or gateway.

requirements.title: Tune Security Event Alerting Thresholds
requirements.source_cadence: Monthly or more frequently. This is the tuning activity, not just a governance meeting.
requirements.guidance: Adjust security-event alert thresholds at least monthly.

operating_guidance.accountable_role: Responsible client team or provider (client to identify)
operating_guidance.client_provider_split: Client approves scope and exceptions; the responsible client team or provider performs the activity and supplies relevant records.
operating_guidance.establish: Examine a dated tuning history, the thresholds considered and the rationale/results. Investigate repeated missed periods and entries that merely acknowledge alerts without evaluating thresholds.
operating_guidance.operate: Adjust security-event alert thresholds at least monthly. Monthly or more frequently. This is the tuning activity, not just a governance meeting.
operating_guidance.dependencies: Safeguard 13.1: Centralize Security Event Alerting

requirements.official_text: Tune security event alerting thresholds monthly, or more frequently.

requirements.title: Establish and Maintain a Security Awareness Program
requirements.source_cadence: Training at hire and annually; content review annually and on significant change
requirements.guidance: Maintain an awareness program and review content; track workforce participation.
requirements.official_text: Establish and maintain a security awareness program. The purpose of a security awareness program is to educate the enterprise’s workforce on how to interact with enterprise assets and data in a secure manner. Conduct training at hire and, at a minimum, annually. Review and update content annually, or when significant enterprise changes occur that could impact this Safeguard.

requirements.title: Train Workforce Members to Recognize Social Engineering Attacks
requirements.guidance: Teach recognition of phishing and other social manipulation.
requirements.official_text: Train workforce members to recognize social engineering attacks, such as phishing, business email compromise (BEC), pretexting, and tailgating.

requirements.title: Train Workforce Members on Authentication Best Practices
requirements.guidance: Teach secure authentication and credential handling.
requirements.official_text: Train workforce members on authentication best practices. Example topics include MFA, password composition, and credential management.

requirements.title: Train Workforce on Data Handling Best Practices
requirements.guidance: Teach safe storage, sharing and disposal of sensitive information.
requirements.official_text: Train workforce members on how to identify and properly store, transfer, archive, and destroy sensitive data. This also includes training workforce members on clear screen and desk best practices, such as locking their screen when they step away from their enterprise asset, erasing physical and virtual whiteboards at the end of meetings, and storing data and assets securely.

requirements.title: Train Workforce Members on Causes of Unintentional Data Exposure
requirements.guidance: Explain accidental disclosure and prevention.
requirements.official_text: Train workforce members to be aware of causes for unintentional data exposure. Example topics include mis-delivery of sensitive data, losing a portable end-user device, or publishing data to unintended audiences.

requirements.title: Train Workforce Members on Recognizing and Reporting Security Incidents
requirements.guidance: Teach workers to identify and report potential incidents.
requirements.official_text: Train workforce members to be able to recognize a potential incident and be able to report such an incident.

requirements.title: Train Workforce on How to Identify and Report if Their Enterprise Assets are Missing Security Updates
requirements.guidance: Teach recognition and reporting of failed security updates.
requirements.official_text: Train workforce to understand how to verify and report out-of-date software patches or any failures in automated processes and tools. Part of this training should include notifying IT personnel of any failures in automated processes and tools.

requirements.title: Train Workforce on the Dangers of Connecting to and Transmitting Enterprise Data Over Insecure Networks
requirements.guidance: Cover insecure connections and safe remote/home networking.
requirements.official_text: Train workforce members on the dangers of connecting to, and transmitting data over, insecure networks for enterprise activities. If the enterprise has remote workers, training must include guidance to ensure that all users securely configure their home network infrastructure.

requirements.title: Conduct Role-Specific Security Awareness and Skills Training
requirements.source_cadence: No separate numeric interval in 14.9; select role-based schedule.
requirements.guidance: Prepare people for their security-specific duties. Deliver role-specific awareness/skills training.

operating_guidance.client_provider_split: Client identifies people/roles; internal trainers or providers deliver and record participation.
operating_guidance.establish: Identify role skills and training gaps.
operating_guidance.operate: Deliver role-specific awareness/skills training.

requirements.official_text: Conduct role-specific security awareness and skills training. Example implementations include secure system administration courses for IT professionals, OWASP® Top 10 vulnerability awareness and prevention training for web application developers, and advanced social engineering awareness training for high-profile roles.

requirements.title: Establish and Maintain an Inventory of Service Providers
requirements.guidance: Inventory providers, classifications and accountable contacts.
requirements.official_text: Establish and maintain an inventory of service providers. The inventory is to list all known service providers, include classification(s), and designate an enterprise contact for each service provider. Review and update the inventory annually, or when significant enterprise changes occur that could impact this Safeguard.
